name: refspatial-bench-placement
description: A benchmark for spatial placement/grounding tasks where models must interpret referring expressions and predict correct spatial placements or object locations in visual scenes. It measures models' spatial reasoning and visual-language grounding ability by comparing predicted placements to ground-truth positions. Typical evaluation focuses on whether the placed object meets positional/relational tolerances.
reputation: A niche, lower-profile dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use in spatial-language and placement research.
